limits: Home-area backgrounds, not personal attributes or observed encounters.
No original weekly replication or independently verified area vintage.
Shared cells are fixed within each service, not identical across services.
Fixed market weights do not fix weights within venues or cells.
Income pooled/between and equal-venue pooled race are unavailable in this summary.
No public-facing, attitude, preference or causal coefficient estimated.
Weighting decomposition is an identity, not a causal explanation.
Within recorded markets still confounds catchments, venue size, provider support and measurement precision.
No independent-person finite-sample correction, original-flow rebuild or new outcomes.
Equal-category summaries are not national visit-weighted averages.
All historical public-facing, timing, geography and upstream-construction gates remain.
